startLine.description: The starting line, 1-based. This must always be specified.

startCol.description: The starting column, 1-based. This will be null if both column numbers are unspecified.

endLine.description:
The ending line, 1-based, inclusive. If specified, this must be ≥ #startLine, If not specified, the highlight is
of a single line.

endCol.description:
The ending column, 1-based, inclusive. If specified, this must be ≥ #startCol if on the same line.
If not specified, the highlight goes to the end of #endLine.

title:
A single highlighted line and/or column range. Lines are 1-based and ranges are inclusive:
 - `3` just the third line
 - `2-4` highlights lines 2, 3, and 4 (inclusive)

It is also possible to specify a span within a line using a period to separate the line number and character
number (also 1-based). For example, `2.12-2.16` specifies 5 characters on the second line starting at the 12th
character.

@see MarkdownFencedCodeBlock#highlights
name: MarkdownFencedCodeBlock.Highlight
